$comment: What the shared tumoOLO_Audits grade this project against. Anything left empty is reported as 'Not measured', never as a pass — so fill a field or accept the gap honestly.

suite.path: resolved by scripts/audit.mjs — AUDIT_SUITE env var, ../tumoOLO_Audits, .audit-suite, or C:/MY BUSINESS COMPANY/tumoOLO_Audits

project.name: MoMo Kasi
project.$note: designSpec/designReference are camelCase because resolveRequirement() in the runner flattens {cfg, cfg.project, cfg.placeholders} and looks up the literal key from registry.json's `requires`. The SCREAMING_SNAKE twins below fill the {{TOKENS}} inside the audit text. Both are needed; they are not a duplicate.

placeholders.$comment: These fill the {{TOKENS}} in the shared audit files.
placeholders.PRIMARY_CTA: Confirm payment — the only control in the app that moves money (ADR-0014)
placeholders.DESIGN_SPEC: src/design/tokens.ts (token source of truth) + docs/13-CHAT-ARTIFACTS-UI.md (structure and behaviour)
placeholders.DESIGN_REFERENCE: C:/Social-Assembly-Main/apps/web — the frontend template this UI is modelled on. Same token architecture, same glowing-black dark palette, same Geist/Playfair pairing; brand deliberately retuned from violet to MTN gold.
placeholders.TARGET_DEVICE: Low-end Android, 320px wide, Slow 3G, direct Highveld sunlight. Not a desktop.
placeholders.CRITICAL_JOURNEY: Ask a question in chat -> an artifact opens with real ledger numbers -> confirm a payment

audits.$comment: Per-audit overrides. A disabled audit needs a reason — the reason is what the next person reads.

A2.reason: The design reference is the Social-Assembly frontend. The seam between 'adopted the system' and 'drifted from it' is exactly what A2 exists to find.

A3.reason: Judges score design, and the target user is on a cracked screen in the sun. A3 outranks A4 for this project.

A6.reason: Light scope — one public landing page. There is no content marketing surface to grade.

A7.reason: No native app, but the offline-first PWA is demoed live in airplane mode. Scoped to PWA / offline / safe-area by docs/audits/A7.project.md; store readiness is N/A.

A9.reason: Needs secret.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which costs money, and this project is R0 (docs/10). Its role — reading each PR diff for introduced vulnerabilities — is covered by manual PR review plus A5 at phases 3, 4 and 6. This is a real gap, not a pass. Re-enable the moment a key exists.

S1.reason: Needs project.siteUrl and a deployment. Set the Vercel URL at Phase 6 and run it once; non-blocking, so it can never gate the submission.
